name: Mozambik Knysna
address: Shop 21 and 22, Knysna Waterfront, Waterfront Dr, Knysna Central, Knysna, 6570, South Africa
description_short: Waterfront Portuguese-inspired restaurant serving flame-grilled peri-peri chicken, prawns, and coastal favourites with lagoon views.
description_long:
Mozambik Knysna brings the flavours of the Portuguese East African coast to the heart of Knysna Waterfront. The restaurant's open-plan design and outdoor seating offer views across the lagoon, making it a popular spot for families and groups looking for a relaxed meal with a view.

The menu centres on flame-grilled peri-peri chicken and seafood platters, with prawns, calamari, and line fish prepared in traditional Mozambican style. Espetadas, burgers, and Portuguese-inspired sides round out the offering. The casual atmosphere and generous portions make it a solid choice for lunch or dinner after exploring the waterfront.

Located at the Knysna Waterfront, it's an easy walk from the harbour and nearby shops. Service is friendly, and the vibe is unpretentious—perfect for a laid-back meal with the family or mates.
